partial_definition: Full means complete licensed grammar-slot alternatives in existing inventory; plus-partial adds all historical blocks including partial source seams. This is not a general full-sentence vs fragment comparison.
comparison_limit: Equal per-root quotas; differing root counts mean unequal aggregate arm compute. Wall-time truncation limits causal quality inference; caching equivalence separately tested on action-limited fixtures.
root_policy: All viable roots per arm retained; same seed applied to every root within each seed cell; no target whitelist.
